en:
This is the final showdown against Tanahashi of the Six
Lunatics. Defeat him and discover the dark secret in
Okada's past!

It's the final battle against the leader of JUSTIS,
Rainmaker. Part the dark clouds and crush Okada's
ambition!

The true masterminds, Satsuki and Komei, have formed
an alliance. The final battle is now. Defeat them and
bring the neon light back to Kamurocho.
Defeat the assassins JUSTIS sent to Onomichi!
Wipe out the remainders of the Yano Army!
Wipe out the remainders of the Naito Army!
Defeat the assassins JUSTIS sent out in Kamurocho!
Wipe out the remainders of the TenCozy Army!
Wipe out the remainders of the Tanahashi Army!
This is round one! Defeat the elites!
This is round two! Defeat the elites!
The third and final round! Brace yourself!
Take out your Monday aggression on some Brawlers!
It's only Tuesday!? Defeat these Gunners!

Get over the Wednesday hump by hurting these
Heavies!

Almost through the week! Defeat the Thursday
Rushers!

Home alone on a Friday night? That's okay, just
take out these Grenadiers!

Battle against a Friend to test the power of the
Kiryu Clan!

This battle pits you against the top of the charts!
Prepare for a fight!

Taste that fresh weekend EXP! Battle on weekends
to really power up the Kiryu Clan!

Complete this mission to obtain an uncommon leader.
Use him to expand the Kiryu Clan's dominance!

The elites have launched an all-out assault! Take a
deep breath and join the fray!

Assassins from New Japan Pro-Wrestling have launched an
attack! Defeat them with the power of the Kiryu Clan!

The Six Lunatics have reunited to launch an attack!
Summon the power of the Kiryu Clan and take them on!

Who are these imposters!? Show them the power of
the one true Kiryu Clan!
Not fulfilling victory conditions within time limit
Toru Yano of the Six Lunatics!
Tetsuya Naito of the Six Lunatics!
Hiroshi Tanahashi of the Six Lunatics!
